# Storyblok

Headless CMS with visual editor for content management and delivery across multiple platforms

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/storyblok/.

## Actions

- **Fetch Content Type Items (GraphQL)** (read-only): Fetch multiple stories/content items using Storyblok's GraphQL API with filtering and pagination.
- **Fetch GraphQL Content Item** (read-only): Fetch a single story in a specific language using Storyblok GraphQL API with field-level translations.
- **Get Datasource Entries** (read-only): Retrieve datasource entries from Storyblok via GraphQL API.
- **Get Page Item** (read-only): Retrieve a single page item by ID or slug from Storyblok using GraphQL.
- **List GraphQL Content Type Items** (read-only): Retrieve multiple content items with pagination, filtering, and relation resolution for any Storyblok content type via GraphQL.
- **Query page items via GraphQL** (read-only): Execute GraphQL queries to retrieve multiple page items from Storyblok with filtering options.
- **Retrieve Links via GraphQL** (read-only): Retrieve links for navigation using Storyblok's GraphQL API.
- **Get Extension/App** (read-only): Retrieve a Storyblok extension/app by ID using the Management API.
- **Get GraphQL Rate Limit** (read-only): Retrieve rate limit information from Storyblok GraphQL API.
- **Retrieve Tags via GraphQL** (read-only): Retrieve tags from Storyblok via GraphQL API.
